TOOLING BURST BL-2v-b — arm B hardening: flipbook dispatch inside the generic G2 path · config hygiene · test alignment (Run C-7, P1; conductor R-C7-6 on defect F-C7-1 found by the outside suite after BL-2v-r1). task_id "BL-2v-b".

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 rows T4s-r2 (GroundVisibility), BL-1a, FL-1b (byte-lock re-baseline rule), FL-6d (tests read artifacts of record), BL-2v (your previous contract) and the new row "BL-2v-b — arm B hardening" (this contract).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. export/godot_import.py (G2: `_g2_config`, `_g2_flipbook_config` ~6325, `_write_g2_flipbook` ~6341, `_g2_flipbook_script` ~6384, the picker `directional` dispatch ~1461, G2_SCRIPT), export/effect_kit.py, runs/C-7/vfx_kits/v9/blackwater_cocktail_e3_V/kit.json, runs/C-5/vfx_kits/kits_v9.json, tests/test_godot_import.py (GroundVisibilityRegressionTests ~1125–1160 incl. VISIBILITY_PROBE + VISIBILITY_WORLD; BlackwaterLandingRuntimeTests; FL6LiveRegistryCLIRegressionTests.test_full_cli_live_registry_emits_all_flame_dance_routes), tests/test_vfx_picker.py (FL4BCatalogueTests.test_eighteen_kits_new_b_binding_and_v2_comparison), tests/run_t0c.py, tests/t0c_suite_output.txt (the outside-suite run after BL-2v-r1: 779 run / 17 FAIL / 4 ERROR — READ the FAIL/ERROR blocks), runs/C-5/artifacts/CS-parallax-in-v10/walkable.json (artifact of record), runs/C-7/t3/BL-2v/ (your previous outputs, READ ONLY).
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY; Godot for headless import/trace only.

DEFECT F-C7-1 (from tests/t0c_suite_output.txt, GroundVisibilityRegressionTests.setUpClass): the test's probe drives every G2 kit through the GENERIC path (`res://scripts/vfx_g2.gd` acquire → release → _sprite → _clock). For blackwater_cocktail_e3_V that path loads `res://vfx/blackwater_cocktail_e3_V/derived/field.png` (never emitted for a flipbook kit) → "Resource file not found", then `get_image` on null (vfx_g2.gd:113/163), `set_shader_parameter` on null (:285) and `instantiate` on null (:231). BL-2v put the flipbook dispatch only in the PICKER's `directional` script, so any other caller of G2.acquire gets a config referencing files that do not exist.

PART A — DISPATCH INSIDE THE GENERIC SCRIPT. `vfx_g2.gd` (G2_SCRIPT) `acquire(...)` itself routes `kit.body_mode == "flipbook"` to the flipbook implementation (call into `vfx_g2_flipbook.gd`, or fold the flipbook body into G2_SCRIPT behind the mode switch — your call, one implementation, no duplicated clock/tick code); `release`/`_clock`/`_sprite` never run the painted-pool path for a flipbook kit. The picker's string-replacement dispatch from BL-2v is REMOVED (one dispatch point, in the script). Trace clause: the test's own VISIBILITY_PROBE (unchanged) runs on a project built with kits_v9.json and reports NO "SCRIPT ERROR" and NO "Resource file not found" — GroundVisibilityRegressionTests.setUpClass completes and its tests run.
PART B — CONFIG HYGIENE. `_g2_flipbook_config` emits ONLY keys whose res:// targets exist after export (no `field`, `fragments`, `pulse`, `Field.tres`/`Pulse.tres` unless written); a NEW test walks every exported kit config in the live catalogue export (19 kits) and asserts every `res://` string resolves to an emitted file — a generic guard, not a V-kit special case.
PART C — BLACKWATER TESTS READ ARTIFACTS OF RECORD (SPEC row FL-6d, N-C5-STAGED-FIXTURES): BlackwaterLandingRuntimeTests (and any other test) reading `runs/C-5/cliffside_v38/...` is re-pointed to `runs/C-5/artifacts/CS-parallax-in-v10/walkable.json` / the current export — same assertions, never weakened; they must RUN (the three error at setUpClass today).
PART D — THE TWO 19-KIT LOCKS (BL-2v-19a/b): FL6LiveRegistryCLIRegressionTests.test_full_cli_live_registry_emits_all_flame_dance_routes and FL4BCatalogueTests.test_eighteen_kits_new_b_binding_and_v2_comparison re-encoded from the current catalogue (19 entries; the V kit named and its role asserted — flipbook, no flame_dance route), with a per-lock old→new→why line attributing every changed assertion to BL-2v (the FL-1b rule). Never a literal that would pass on 18 or 20.
PART E — tests/run_t0c.py: the summary writer crashes on `unittest.loader._ErrorHolder` (setUpClass errors) with "Object of type _ErrorHolder is not JSON serializable" and leaves t0c_summary.json STALE — serialise `t.id()`/`str(t)` for holders so the summary is always rewritten; the runner's exit code and t0c_suite_output.txt unchanged.
PART F — RED TABLE, never weaken: run the full outside suite ONCE in your sandbox at the end (python3 -B tests/run_t0c.py; ≤ 15 min) and write runs/C-7/t3/BL-2v-b/reds.json: every remaining FAIL/ERROR with a classification — inherited (name the C-5 lap that owns it: five standing oracle reds, E3-r1 catalogue lock, FL-5/FL-6 stale-value, sandbox-only) or NEW (yours — fix it or say why not). Two FL-5/FL-6 stale-value examples seen today: test_defaults_absent_and_real_fire_fields_load (at_age 24 vs 28) and test_all_new_fields_validate_in_actual_catalogue (paint_end_age 26 vs 30) — these are FL-5 stale encodings; re-encode from the current fields ONLY if you can attribute the change to a named FL-5/FL-6 clause in SPEC.md; otherwise leave red and NAMED.
ACCEPTANCE (runs/C-7/t3/BL-2v-b/acceptance.json): Part A probe clause (VISIBILITY_PROBE clean on the 19-kit project); Part B new guard green on 19 kits; Part C the Blackwater runtime tests RUN (pass/fail listed, never skipped); Part D per-lock diffs; Part E a summary written despite a forced setUpClass error (unit test of the writer); Part F reds.json; 19-kit export exit 0; headless import exit 0 (gl_compatibility); ALL 18 original kits + the V kit's frames byte-identical; arm B's ab_trace.json re-run (probe_ab.gd from BL-2v) byte-identical on every event field except timestamps.
DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, oracle/, export/replay.py, any kit's primitives/frames, anything under runs/ except runs/C-7/t3/BL-2v-b/ and runs/C-7/vfx_kits/v9/blackwater_cocktail_e3_V/kit.json (config only, if a key must move); fixtures/ only for a new fixture of your own. Do not run the Godot editor GUI. Do not deploy. Confine Godot logs to runs/C-7/t3/BL-2v-b/.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "BL-2v-b"): files = every changed path with sha256; images = 0 (INTEGER); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED with concerns listed honestly.
